context: Two teens debrief a hectic festival prep day
purpose: Teach: いっそう/気が付い/解ら/みえ/陽気/続々/絶えず/浮上

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、ふと気が付いたらもう夜じゃない？準備、まだ全然終わってないよ。
lines.en: Hey Riku, I just realized it's already night. We're nowhere near done with the prep.
lines.style: Sakura sounds tired but warmly familiar, slightly teasing her old friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 本当だ。屋台のとこ、客が続々と下見に来てて、もう何が何だか解らないよ。
lines.en: Seriously. People keep streaming by the stalls to scope things out, I have no clue what's going on anymore.
lines.style: Riku is overwhelmed but trying to laugh it off, voice slightly hoarse.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 向こうから提灯の灯りがみえてきたとき、いっそう本番が近いって感じたな。
lines.en: When the lantern lights came into view from over there, it hit me even harder that the main event is close.
lines.style: Sakura grows quietly excited, almost dreamy as she pictures the scene.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。会長が絶えずマイクで指示出してて、耳が痛いくらいだった。
lines.en: Totally. The chairperson was barking orders into the mic nonstop, my ears were ringing.
lines.style: Riku complains with exaggerated exhaustion, half-laughing through it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、急に音響トラブルが浮上したじゃん？あれ、誰が直したの？
lines.en: But hey, that sound system issue suddenly came up, right? Who ended up fixing it?
lines.style: Sakura asks with genuine curiosity, leaning in to hear the gossip.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 山田先輩。あの人、いつも陽気に騒いでるけど、やる時はやるんだよな。
lines.en: Yamada-senpai. That guy's always goofing around cheerfully, but when it counts, he delivers.
lines.style: Riku speaks with sincere admiration, voice softening with respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日も忙しくなりそう。今夜くらいゆっくり寝なきゃ体がもたないよ。
lines.en: Tomorrow's going to be wild too. We've got to sleep properly tonight or our bodies won't hold up.
lines.style: Sakura sighs, sounding maternal and practical at the same time.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だな。じゃあまた朝集合で。おやすみ、桜。
lines.en: Yeah. See you at the morning meetup then. Night, Sakura.
lines.style: Riku signs off softly, voice already drifting toward sleep.
